premise: On a clear night Plesiosaur floats on his back in the lagoon, eyes closed, listening to the night; Parasaurolophus can't sleep and Glider is wide awake; a shooting star streaks by, then another, and each makes a wish — the last wish is to do this again tomorrow.
inspiration: The wishing star of folk rhyme ('Star light, star bright'), with a wish that has already come true.
lesson: The best wishes are often for what we already have.

en-US.title: Wishes on the Lagoon
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.8} {sfx:night} [softly] It was a clear, warm night, and the moon was up. {plesiosaur:enter} {plesiosaur:go to lagoon} Plesiosaur lay floating on the lagoon, {plesiosaur:face happy} {plesiosaur:live float hold} face up to the sky, eyes closed, listening to the night. On the shore, {parasaurolophus:enter} {parasaurolophus:go to shore} Parasaurolophus {parasaurolophus:live stretch} stretched and yawned, but she just couldn't sleep. {glider:enter} {glider:go to branches} And on his branch, little Glider was wide awake. {glider:face happy} [whispers] "Psst!" {glider:live look-around} "Look up!" {canvas:shootingstars 0.6} Whoosh… a shooting star streaked across the sky. {plesiosaur:live float resume} Plesiosaur opened his eyes. {parasaurolophus:face surprised} [in awe] "Ooh! Make a wish!" said Parasaurolophus. So they did. {parasaurolophus:face happy} Parasaurolophus wished for a brand-new song. {parasaurolophus:sparkle} Glider wished for the longest glide ever. {glider:sparkle} And Plesiosaur thought, and thought. [warmly] "I wish," he said, "we could all do this again tomorrow." {plesiosaur:glow 0.5} Another star flew by. [happily] "That one's easy," said Parasaurolophus. "We'll be right here." {all:face sleeping} And one by one, under the twinkling stars, they all fell asleep.

es-ES.title: Deseos en la laguna
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.8} {sfx:night} [softly] Era una noche clara y templada, y había salido la luna. {plesiosaur:enter} {plesiosaur:go to lagoon} Plesiosaurio flotaba en la laguna, {plesiosaur:face happy} {plesiosaur:live float hold} boca arriba, con los ojos cerrados, escuchando la noche. En la orilla, {parasaurolophus:enter} {parasaurolophus:go to shore} Parasaurolophus {parasaurolophus:live stretch} se estiró y bostezó, pero no había manera de dormirse. {glider:enter} {glider:go to branches} Y en su rama, el pequeño Planeador estaba despierto del todo. {glider:face happy} [whispers] —¡Psst! {glider:live look-around} ¡Mirad arriba! {canvas:shootingstars 0.6} Fiuuu… una estrella fugaz cruzó el cielo. {plesiosaur:live float resume} Plesiosaurio abrió los ojos. {parasaurolophus:face surprised} [in awe] —¡Oh! ¡Pedid un deseo! —dijo Parasaurolophus. Y eso hicieron. {parasaurolophus:face happy} Parasaurolophus deseó una canción nueva. {parasaurolophus:sparkle} Planeador deseó el planeo más largo del mundo. {glider:sparkle} Y Plesiosaurio pensó, y pensó. [warmly] —Yo deseo —dijo— que mañana podamos hacer esto otra vez. {plesiosaur:glow 0.5} Pasó otra estrella. [happily] —Ese es fácil —dijo Parasaurolophus—. Aquí estaremos. {all:face sleeping} Y uno a uno, bajo las estrellas, se quedaron todos dormidos.
